ambientMotion.formula: wx = (c.x + t*4.5) mod 2400; screen x = wx + 64. Speed 4.5 px/s for all 7; wrap period 533.3 s. Opacity = 0.92*0.96*edge, edge = min(wx/200, (2400-wx)/200, 1): a wrapped cloud reappears at screen x 64 at opacity 0 and fades in over its first 200 px (44.4 s); the fade-out side is off-screen (clouds leave the frame once wx > 1856). Base positions at t=0: x = i*342.86 + random('cl-x'+i)*130.3 -> 105.2, 357.5, 741.8, 1092.0, 1456.4, 1805.9, 2116.2; y = 50 + random('cl-y'+i)*210; w = 220 + random('cl-w'+i)*280 -> 280.9, 351.8, 372.6, 308.2, 388.1, 433.7, 408.3.

ambientMotion.what: Birds drift right, bob and flap
ambientMotion.formula: x = ((rx*2300 + t*(14 + rs*10)) mod 2580) - 140, screen x = x + 64 (speeds 21.38, 16.71, 19.77, 19.54 px/s; they cross the frame and are off-screen right for part of each ~120-155 s loop). y = 120 + ry*190 + 9*sin(0.7t + 2.2i) (+-9 px, period 8.98 s; mid heights 186.6, 253.7, 180.5, 247.9). Wing flap: arc control y = -3.2 - 3.4*sin(7t + 1.9i) (period 0.90 s), times scale s = 0.85 + rs*0.5.
glow radius = 52*4.6 + (0.5 + 0.5*sin(0.55t))*52*0.15 = 239.2 .. 247.0 px, period 11.42 s (242.1 at t = 185/30). Halo, disc and ring are static.
circle opacity = 0.2 + 0.8*(0.5 + 0.5*sin(pi*t)) = 0.2 .. 1.0, period 2 s (0.80 at t = 185/30), multiplied by the tower group opacity 0.95.

body translate y (local units, x2 on screen) = run*sin(frame*1.15)*1.3 + (1-run)*(settleBob + 0.35*sin(1.4t)); at the hold run = 0 and settleBob = exp(-(185-62)/9)*... ~ 0, so y = 0.35*sin(1.4t) local = +-0.7 px on screen, period 4.49 s (+0.5 px at t = 185/30). Pitch is 0. Wheels and ground shadows do not move.

Everything else is frozen at the hold
ambientMotion.formula: Diffing world(185, t) against world(185, t+3.37) changes only 21 attributes: sun glow r; 7 cloud transforms (+ cloud #0 opacity while it fades in); 4 bird transforms and 4 wing paths; tower beacon opacity; the 3 truck body transforms. Buildings, windows, poles, wires, road, vending machines, supplier, hill, haze, sky and vignette have no motion. The player continues ambient time from the entrance without a jump (entrance uses t = frame/30, hold starts at 185/30), and carries the elapsed hold time into scene 02's entrance (ambOff).

ambientMotion.what: Player camera drift on narrow viewports only (outside the scene function)
ambientMotion.formula: Desktop: static crop centred on stage x 780. As the visible window narrows (mobT = clamp((1500 - boxW/scale)/880)), the crop blends toward CAM_M[0]: centre x 840 -> 1030, y 660 -> 680, zoom 1.10 -> 1.18 across the 7 s dwell with ease-in-out, exponentially smoothed (rate 2.6/s). Reduced motion: fixed at the midpoint.

choreography.what: Camera fixed at x = -200. The pan to the warehouse only starts at frame 200 (panStart) and ends at 262. Entrance is played at 36 frames per second by the player (ENTER_RATE 1.2), so frames 0-185 take about 5.14 s.

Truck 1 waits at world x -400: its rear is at screen x -200 and its front bumper at screen x 152, so the cab already pokes into the left 152 px of the frame (confirmed in render). The weight model treats it as already driving: body shakes +-1.3 local units (sin(frame*1.15)), exhaust puffs visible (opacity up to 0.7), pitch 0.

Truck drives in from the left and brakes: rear x (world) = -400 + 1160*easeOutCubic((f-8)/54). Screen rear x by frame: 8: -200, 12: 39, 16: 243, 20: 414, 24: 556, 28: 670, 32: 761, 36: 830, 40: 882, 44: 917, 48: 940, 52: 953, 56: 958, 62: 960. Enters at full speed (63 px/frame at f 9) and decelerates all the way. Nose dips under braking: pitch peaks at +1.25 deg at f 19 (rotation about local 92,80), 0.69 deg at f 40, 0.09 deg at f 62. Road shake fades as speed drops (run < 1 from about f 51, 0.03 at f 60). Wheels rotate with distance; two exhaust puffs cycle every 90 px and fade with speed.

Truck parked at screen x 960. Settle bounce: exp(-(f-62)/9)*sin((f-62)/2.2)*3.4 local units (first swing about +2.2 local = 4.4 px down at f 64-66, then -1.2 at f 72, gone by about f 95); pitch rocks back slightly to -0.03 deg at f 70 then 0. Idle bob 0.35*sin(1.4t) continues underneath.

Rear door opens, linear 0 -> 1. The dark door panel grows out behind the box (screen width 14.7 px at f 66, 27 at f 70, 32.5 at f 74, 34 at f 80; final position x 916-950, y 754-862) and fades in; a dark recess strip appears just inside the rear edge (x 963-981).

Three parcels, one every 26 frames, each lasting 34 frames (so the next starts 8 frames before the previous ends). Each parcel: 0-13% squashes in anticipation at the dock point (screen 758.8, 838.2) with its shadow on the dock; 13-56% flies an arc to the pavement at screen (914, 880) - bottom-centre peaks near y 795, tilts up to 2.5 deg, stretches 5%, shadow on the ground at 30%; 56-66% landing squash 12%; 66-76% small settle wobble; 76-100% hops up and right into the truck toward screen (1000, 860) and is clipped at the truck's rear edge x 960, so it vanishes into the box. Phase frames for parcel 1: 82-86.4, 86.4-101, 101-104.4, 104.4-107.8, 107.8-116 (add 26 and 52 for parcels 2 and 3). Door stays fully open throughout (80-172).
Short beat: last parcel is inside, door still fully open, nothing moves except ambient.

Rear door closes, linear 1 -> 0 (k = 0.75 at f 176, 0.5 at f 180, 0.25 at f 184, 0.1875 at f 185, 0 at f 188). The scene-01 hold stops at f 185, i.e. BEFORE the door has finished closing: the door is frozen as a 12 px wide sliver at 35% opacity for the whole hold. It only finishes closing in the first 3 frames of scene 02's entrance (185-188).
Truck parked at screen x 960-1312, door ghost as above, no parcels, exhaust invisible, pitch 0, only ambient motion runs. Ambient time continues from 185/30 s.
